decisions.reason: The same client acceptance already introduces the D2D-specific cover and records that it is separate from the Amazon cover; no additional MODIFY is needed.
Creating separate platform-specific covers does not change the required blurb reflow or barcode-clearance rule.
The decision to create separate platform-specific covers does not change the required PSD, PDF, and JPG formats, and the source does not specify a new format-to-variant rule.
Producing separate covers for differing platform specifications does not revoke or alter the constraint against redesigning the established cover.
The platform-specific output decision does not change the required title typography or the panels that must match the front-cover style.
